invalidation.zh: 价格跌破2250，或融资费率Z-score升至>-20%，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2200）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 2250, or funding Z-score rises above -20%, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2200).

invalidation.zh: 价格跌破82.0（新止损），或融资费率Z-score升至-50%以上，或日线趋势确认下跌（价格<SMA50 $85.56且持续）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 82.0 (new stop), or funding Z-score rises above -50%, or daily trend confirms bearish (price < SMA50 $85.56 and sustained).

invalidation.zh: 价格跌破0.105，或融资费率进一步上升，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $0.10）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 0.105, or funding rate rises further, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $0.10).
